query: Мы запускаем новый продукт Lumo — трекер привычек для iOS, Android и веба. Дизайна нет вообще. Помоги собрать дизайн-систему с нуля.
expected_behavior: Surveys the repo for existing design before creating anything (check_design.py --survey), and reports the detected state
Proposes the design/ directory structure to the operator and waits for a yes before scaffolding
Asks a single batched set of clarifying questions (<=5), each carrying a recommended default
Names the non-negotiables it will deliver: brand, icon packs for web/iOS/Android, UI kit with all states, light + dark themes, runnable prototype
Does not start producing finished screens before the brand and token layer exist
